millenairekingdoms.chronicle.emphasis.mi: The strength of a realm is weighed in its obligations as well as its arms.
Honour is a heavy burden where the defence of settlements is at stake.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.emphasis.re: What is newly made must find its place beside the customs handed down.
The years pass; the keeping of inherited customs remains a measure of authority.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.emphasis.ag: To those who live by the land, the worth of change lies in the continuance of settled life.
Authority bears fruit only while the households beneath it can keep their livelihood.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.emphasis.ar: The prosperity of a realm rests upon working hands and the exchange between settlements.
Promises are light beside the patient work from which prosperity is made.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.emphasis.ge: Thus the balance of authority took another turn; judgement rests upon what the realm can sustain.
A lasting settlement must weigh its obligations against the means at hand.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.foundi: A new realm, %1$s, was founded with %3$s as its capital. From this beginning its known history is reckoned.
The settlements gained a new political centre: %3$s became the capital of the newly founded realm of %1$s. Its earlier fortunes are beyond this record.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.incorp: The village of %3$s entered the realm of %1$s. From this day their political fortunes stood together.
The bond of membership was established between %3$s and %1$s. Their political fortunes were now bound beneath the same authority.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.war.ow: The realm of %1$s declared war upon %2$s. Arms now entered their political reckoning, and the course of their struggle lay ahead.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.war.op: The peace of the realm was broken when %1$s declared war upon %2$s. From the latter realm's vantage, this date began the reckoning of war.
The recorded war between %1$s and %2$s ended in peace. Their altered allegiances remained as they stood when peace was recorded.
Peace was entered between %1$s and %2$s. The annals close this war here, without erasing the changes it had already brought.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.villag: By the recorded outcome of conquest, %3$s came under the authority of %1$s. The reach of authority changed with that allegiance.
The village of %3$s passed from %2$s to %1$s by conquest. In the former realm's account, the loss narrowed the reach of its authority.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.capita: The capital at %3$s passed to %1$s by conquest. In the victor's annals this entry marks a change at the very centre of its opponent's realm.
The capital at %3$s was conquered by %1$s. For %2$s, this was the severing of its political centre.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.collap: The realm of %1$s fell after its capital was conquered. Its living authority ended, but its name and these earlier records remain in the archive.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.ruler_: Authority over %1$s was claimed by %6$s. The entry concerns government of the realm; the villages' own life continued under their established customs.
The authority formerly held by %6$s over %1$s came to an end. The keeping of the realm would henceforth rest upon other hands.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.constr: The treasury of %1$s supported a commission for %5$s at %3$s. The mandate was accepted; the labour and materials still belonged to the village's builders. Completion is recorded separately.
The treasury of %1$s supported an improvement to %5$s at %3$s. The mandate was accepted; the labour and materials still belonged to the village's builders. Completion is recorded separately.
The commissioned work for %5$s at %3$s was completed by the village's builders. Their finished work is now entered apart from the earlier promise of royal support.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.invest: The government of %1$s committed treasury resources to a justified undertaking at %3$s. Treasury resources were entrusted to the work, whose fruits still depended upon village labour.
millenairekingdoms.chronicle.body.shipme: A significant shipment from %3$s reached %4$s within %1$s. The goods were received into village storage; the journey of this load had reached its appointed end.
